annotations.title: Look up a House or Senate meeting

description: One meeting of the Georgia House or Senate (a floor session, a standing committee, or the Rules Committee) by its address (2026-02-05/house-rules), the General Assembly's video id or URL, or a body and a date (House Rules 2/5/2026), as the Markdown twin the site serves: frontmatter (cite_as, canonical_url, source_url = the video), the machine-transcript notice, the summary and the bill discussions Georgia Commons wrote (one heading per bill, each with its moment in the video and the official record that confirms it), the bills read aloud, then the timestamped transcript. Speakers are not identified. A long transcript is cut after its first 20,000 characters, and the response ends with the call for the rest; `start` returns one part of the transcript alone, as the frontmatter's `parts` list says.

meeting.description: The meeting: its address (2026-02-05/house-rules), the General Assembly's video id or URL, or a body and a date (House Rules 2/5/2026).
meeting.title: Meeting

start.description: A character offset into the transcript: returns that part of the transcript alone instead of the meeting with its summaries.
start.title: Start
